reviews.text:
We interviewed few builders before deciding who should build our home and we picked Fred. It was a great choice!  We were new to the area but not new to the process. Fred was able to get answers on things we weren’t familiar with in this area. He did good job of keeping us informed on everything and even coming to us when things that were not so great. If he didn’t have answers to our questions he would find out. We liked going with the cost plus option because we were able to see where all of the costs went in the house and able to pick out every detail.  We have been in our home for 1-1/2 years.  It took 9 months to build, which I thought could have been quicker, but it was what it was. We would not hesitate to recommend Fred to anyone or hesitate to contact him if we had a question on anything.  He is more than happy to take our call.

Mickey and Tammy Marlow

data.summary: The reviews appear authentic and reflect a small, well-regarded custom home builder. The low volume of reviews is more indicative of a niche, high-end business with few clients per year rather than manipulation. The detailed, specific content of the primary review and the unique secondary review are strong authenticity signals.
fake_signals: Very low total review volume (3-5 reviews per platform)
One review is extremely brief and generic ('Splendid Custom Home Building Services')
authentic_signals: Specific, detailed narrative from a homeowner (Mickey and Tammy Marlow) including project timeline (9 months), contract type (cost plus), and post-move-in support
Unique, credible scenario from a non-customer (Paul Nguyen) regarding property access
Varied author names and writing styles
Reviews span several years (7, 6, and 3 years ago)
data.discrepancy_explanation: All available ratings are consistently high (4.6-5.0) and positive. The A+ BBB rating with no complaints aligns with the positive customer feedback.
